kultivator.guide.c21.abadi.body: A far target: a disciple walks the whole way to True Immortal without being carried by its master.
kultivator.guide.c21.abadi.title: True Immortal on Its Own
kultivator.guide.c21.belanja.body:
With its pocket money a disciple goes down to town for pills, materials and gear, haggles and sometimes meets a pickpocket.
It brings home gifts and stories; a stall it visits often becomes its regular merchant.
kultivator.guide.c21.belanja.title: Down to Town
kultivator.guide.c21.cita.body:
Each disciple holds up to three goals: the next realm, winning the tournament, avenging a defeat, making a fine work...
Support the goals you like. When one is reached it writes it with a red ribbon in its diary.
kultivator.guide.c21.cita.title: A Goal Reached
kultivator.guide.c21.harian.body:
Disciples write a diary every day that matters: the weather, what happened, how they felt and their goals.
Open the Life Path tab > Diary, or [Open Book] for 40 entries and the travel scrolls. Unloaded disciples can be read from the board.
kultivator.guide.c21.harian.title: Read the Diary
kultivator.guide.c21.jalan.body:
Every disciple chooses its own life path from its traits, talent, Dao, root and memories: Swordsman, Alchemist, Formation Master, Hermit, Adventurer, Hunter, Merchant, Scholar or Guardian.
Open the disciple scroll, then the Life Path tab. It tells why it chose that path, and you can push it toward another.
kultivator.guide.c21.jalan.title: Life Paths
kultivator.guide.c21.kebijakan.body:
On the Disciples' Life Paths board (hub, Disciples section) you set Full, Balanced or Obedient autonomy, caution, pocket money and allowed activities.
A single disciple can get its own policy from the Policy page of its scroll. The master's orders always win.
kultivator.guide.c21.kebijakan.title: Hall Policy
kultivator.guide.c21.seteru.body: Disciples of other sects can become rivals. Make peace or settle it with an official duel; there is no war and no death.
kultivator.guide.c21.seteru.title: The End of a Feud
kultivator.guide.c21.tembus.body:
A ready disciple waits some days for the master, then breaks through on its own with its preparation pills, guarded by a friend as Hu Fa.
Set how long it waits and the careful stance on the board.
kultivator.guide.c21.tembus.title: Breaking Through Alone
kultivator.guide.chapter.21.desc: Disciples who choose a life path, shop in town, break through alone and keep a diary: how to guide without ruling everything.
kultivator.screen.help.mandiri:
Sect disciples live on their own. Each morning the planner picks activities from seven drives (hunger to cultivate, boredom, fatigue, social, ambition, goods, wounds), the life path, goals and hall policy.

Life Path: ten paths (nine choices and the Demonic Path). Temptation from 60 up is dangerous; rebuke it, break through together, or redeem it in the hall.

Goals: up to three, by priority. [Support] makes one the main goal; Realm and Master cannot be cancelled.

Money: daily pocket money from the hall funds by rank, wages and crafts. [Give money] puts the spirit stones in your hand into the purse.

Journeys: shopping, guild missions, hunts, ruins, caves, wandering. Disciples can be wounded or taken, never killed; rescue or ransom them.

Diary: written from real events in your language. A red ribbon marks the big days.

Policy: Full, Balanced, Obedient; caution; 16 activity groups. The master's orders always win.
kultivator.screen.help.mandiri.title: Autonomous Disciples

kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.ajar.dia: Senior %1$s showed me the heart of %2$s.
%1$s repeated %2$s ten times without complaint until I understood.
I got it wrong three times, and %1$s kept smiling. %2$s finally sank in.

%1$s picked up %2$s quickly. I am proud.
%1$s asked something about %2$s I had never considered. I learned as much as they did.
Seeing %1$s perform %2$s correctly made me happier than mastering it myself.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.ajar.tet: Elder %1$s taught me %2$s while the master was away.
In the pavilion, %1$s guided me through %2$s.
%1$s gave me a lesson in %2$s. I will train hard.
Elder %1$s was strict and impatient, but the %2$s they taught I will never forget.

kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.ambisi.b: I passed calamity number %1$s. Heaven tested, I endured.

kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.ambisi.t: I challenged myself in the training arena today.

Five opponents, five wins. I am still hungry.
I challenged the senior who never loses. This time I almost won.
During those days I studied %1$s.
Quietly I practised %1$s every night.
Little by little I began to understand %1$s.
Between chores I stole time for %1$s. Little by little even a hill is climbed.
Notes on %1$s fill three pages of my book.
Watching the waterfall, %1$s suddenly became clear. I understood it on my own!
Enlightenment! I found %1$s without a teacher.
Like mist parting, %1$s opened in my mind.
A crane landed on the pond, and its movement was %1$s. I laughed out loud.
No scroll, no teacher: %1$s was born from tonight's silence.
I began studying %1$s from the scroll in my bag.
I opened the %1$s scroll slowly. Its characters are hard.
Tonight I read %1$s until the candle burned out.
I pressed the %1$s jade slip to my forehead and its characters flowed like water.
I have read the first page of %1$s ten times. The second page tomorrow.
At last I have mastered %1$s!
I finished the %1$s scroll, and the technique lives in my hands.
%1$s is mine now.
The last movement of %1$s came out on its own, and the courtyard wind turned with it.

%1$s! It cost %2$s NB, but it was worth it.

The %1$s scroll, %2$s NB. I hugged it all the way home.

kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.buka.bad: A storm raged; lightning struck behind the mountains.
Thunder shook the windows, and I thought of tribulation lightning.
The storm wind tore the bamboo leaves away.
The sky was black; the qi churned like boiling water.
Storm rain hammered the roofs all day.
Lightning lit the courtyard for an instant, then dark again.
Everyone sheltered inside; the storm gave no mercy.
In the storm the sect's guarding formation hummed loudly.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.buka.bul: A moonless night; there seemed to be more stars.
Pitch dark; only the hall lanterns burned.
New moon: a night fit for silent contemplation.
The sky was clean black, the Milky Way stretched like a river.
Without the moon, the wind sounded clearer.
A dark night; I walked slowly so as not to trip.
Fireflies showed clearly on the moonless night.
In a darkness like this, people say, heart demons come more easily.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.buka.faj: Dawn broke behind the eastern peak.
The morning bell rang; I was already sitting cross-legged.
Morning mist drifted between the pavilions.
The first light touched the hall roof, golden.
The spirit rooster crowed too early again.
The dawn air was fresh; the purple qi from the east is purest now.
I rose before the others and swept the yard.
Dew dripped from the tips of the bamboo leaves.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.buka.huj: A thin rain fell from the morning, wetting the hall roofs.
The rain on the tiles made it hard to concentrate.
Heavy rain; the footpaths turned into little streams.
The air was wet and cold, the qi of heaven and earth felt heavy.
My paper umbrella leaked again today.
Mist and drizzle hid the far peaks.
The rain did not stop; the smell of wet earth filled the courtyard.
Under the rain the lotus pond rippled without end.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.buka.jal: A dusty road stretched beyond the hill.
We set out before dawn; dew still on the grass.
Birds burst from the bushes as we passed.
The milestone said there was still a long way.
At the crossroads a farmer showed us the way.
The sun was harsh; we rested under an old tree.
A stream by the road glittered in the sun.
The path cut through a fragrant pine forest.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.buka.kot: The streets of %1$s were busy from the morning.
The smell of steamed buns and incense filled the market of %1$s.
The market drum of %1$s sounded as I arrived.
The gate of %1$s was full of merchants and carts.
In %1$s every corner had the sound of haggling.
The red lanterns of %1$s swayed in the wind.
The guards of %1$s looked me over, then let me pass.
The teahouse of %1$s was full of gossiping people.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.buka.mal: Stars were scattered above the hall.
The cold night wind crept through the window.
Late at night, the hall was asleep.
An owl called in the woods behind.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.buka.pur: The moon was full, qi fell like dew.
The full moon bathed the courtyard in silver.
A full-moon night: the best time to absorb the moon's essence.
Under the round moon my shadow lay sharp on the stone.
The full moon hung above the peak, large and calm.
Tonight was so bright I needed no lantern.
Night insects sang under the full moon.
The elders say Yin qi is purest at the full moon.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.buka.sal: Snow fell slowly, covering the stone stairs in white.
My breath smoked; the snow lay a palm deep in the yard.
The pine branches bowed under the snow.
Bitter cold; I warmed my hands with qi.
The world was silent under the snow, only my footsteps creaked.
The year's first snow; the juniors ran about in delight.
The wind blew snowflakes into the corridor.
The pond froze; the spirit fish slept under the ice.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.buka.sen: The dusk bell rang long from the tower.
Crows flew home to the old pines.
The lanterns were lit one by one.
The dusk light turned the pond copper.
The dusk wind carried the smell of cooking from the kitchen.
The sun sank behind layered mountains.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.buka.sia: The sun stood high; the yard stones felt warm.
A quiet noon at the hall.
The tree shadows were short at midday.
A soft breeze moved the pavilion curtains.
A clear day; disciples drilled in the yard.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.contoh.b: On the way home from the ruins, %2$s bandits blocked us. %1$s parried two, I brought down the third. We laughed the rest of the way.
The pill merchant %2$s asked %4$s stones for one %3$s; I haggled down to %5$s and they grumbled as they wrapped it.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.contoh.p: Senior %1$s broke through to %2$s in the courtyard, and I stood guard to the last bolt. A little envious. But mostly proud.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.contoh.t: %1$s brewed chrysanthemum tea on the veranda while the snow fell. We hardly spoke; there was no need.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.dao.bimb: I hesitate: is the %1$s Dao truly my path?
The %1$s Dao calls, but my heart is unsure.
All night I thought about the %1$s Dao.
Sword or water, fire or silence? The %1$s Dao keeps coming back to my mind.
I asked the stars about the %1$s Dao. They only twinkled.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.dao.upac: Today I chose the %1$s Dao. This Dao is my path.
Before the incense I swore to walk the %1$s Dao.
The %1$s Dao answered my call. The ceremony is done.
A pillar of light came down from the sky as I named the %1$s Dao. The whole hall came out to watch.
The %1$s Dao. A few words, but my whole life is inside them.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.dewa.pil: I chose %1$s as my divine art.
The divine art %1$s is carved into my soul.
With %1$s I step into the divine.
As %1$s joined my soul, I felt a warmth like the first morning of spring.
The divine art %1$s. The seniors call it a bold choice. I call it an honest one.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.hati.gag: The Heart Trial threw me down. I still see that shadow when I close my eyes.
The heart demon won this time. The road to %1$s is closed for now.
My heart is not clear enough for %1$s.
I cried like a child in the middle of the trial. Perhaps my heart is still too young for %1$s.
The heart demon wore the master's face and I wavered. I must make peace with myself first.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.hati.lul: The heart demon came wearing the faces of those I love. I did not waver. The road to %1$s is open.
The Heart Trial is over. Those shadows could not fool me.
I saw my own fear, and walked past it.
The heart demon offered all I ever wanted. I refused, and it shattered like glass.
A stronger shadow of myself challenged me. I forgave it, and it vanished. %1$s awaits.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.hufa.jag: I guarded %1$s until they broke through to %2$s. The lightning never touched them.
%1$s reached %2$s, and I stood beside them the whole time.
Guarding %1$s taught me what a fellow disciple means.
Lightning aimed at %1$s and I turned it aside with all my qi. Now they stand in %2$s.
%1$s hugged me after reaching %2$s. My robe is a little singed, but that is fine.
%1$s approved my rise to %2$s.
Elder %1$s patted my shoulder: I am now a %2$s.
With the blessing of %1$s, I became a %2$s.
%1$s read my request, raised an eyebrow, then stamped it: %2$s.
Without the master, %1$s approved it. I am now a %2$s, and I will tell the master when they return.
My rank request was postponed. I must prove myself again.
Not yet time to rise, they said.
Disappointed, but I will try harder.
The elder says my merit is not enough yet. I will gather it one by one.
Postponed again. I swept the courtyard until night to calm myself.
I asked to rise to the rank of %1$s.
I handed in my request for the rank of %1$s.
I hope my request to become %1$s is approved.
I straightened my robe and handed in my request for %1$s with both hands.
My list of merits for the rank of %1$s is complete. Now I wait.
I rose to the rank of %1$s!
The new robe of a %1$s feels heavy and proud.
Today I officially became a %1$s.
The juniors called me %1$s and I looked behind me for someone else. It was me.
I pinned the badge of a %1$s to my chest. My hand shook a little.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.pil.lumb: I took %1$s from the sect Granary.
%1$s from the Granary helped my training.
The Granary keeper wrote down my name before handing over %1$s. I will repay it someday.
%1$s from the sect Granary. It tasted like home cooking.
%1$s was terribly bitter, but my qi rose at once like fire fed with oil.
I had saved %1$s for a dire moment. Today that moment came.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.renung.a: I must be faster than the others.
One day I will stand at the summit.
Every spirit stone brings me closer.
The summit is still far, but I can see it already.
One day my name will be carved on the sect's stele.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.renung.b: If there is danger, let me go first.
A sword never tested grows dull.
Tomorrow I will try again, harder.
If I fall, I simply get up again.
Fear is only a shadow; cut through it.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.renung.l: What matters is the result, not the way.
I have a backup plan ready.
Honest people eat last. I do not like being hungry.
As long as the master does not know, nothing is wrong.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.renung.m: Why is everyone in such a hurry?
Maybe there is an easier way.
Tomorrow. I will surely feel more like it tomorrow.
Why hurry when a cultivator lives so long?
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.renung.p: I still tremble thinking of it.
I hope nothing strange happens tomorrow.
It is safer near the hall.
I want to be stronger so I am not afraid anymore.
Lucky no one saw my knees shaking.
Tonight I sleep with the lantern lit.
One day I will repay this debt.
I keep note of every insult.
Let time prove who was right.
Every insult I write down. Every note I will repay.
Their smiles today will be their tears tomorrow.
May everyone at the hall be well.
I set a little aside for the juniors.
A warm heart strengthens qi too.
I am glad I could help.
Tomorrow I will bring porridge to the sick junior.
I wonder if the hall cat has eaten yet.
kultivator.sekte.mandiri.harian.renung.r: Tomorrow I will rise even earlier.
A day without training is a step back.
There is still so much to learn.
One more form before bed will not kill me.
Master says patience is part of cultivation too.
